d: Tavern on the border of Saxony. Carlo Moor immersed in reading a book.

Bedroom in the bunk. Massimiliano Moor sleeping on a chair. Amalia approaches slowly and stops to contemplate him.
Francesco and Arminio disguised. The precedents.

Arminius agitated. Amalia.
Francesco, Amalia.

Carlo Moor, the Masnadieri rise and greet him.
Carlo solo.

Escape of several rooms. Francesco enters hasty and upset.
